{"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["app/profiles.py:8:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:9:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:10:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:15:test-failure"], "search": "    bio: Optional[str]
    website: Optional[str]
    age: Optional[int]", "replace": "    bio: Optional[str] = None
    website: Optional[str] = None
    age: Optional[int] = None", "explanation": "In Pydantic v1, a bare Optional[X] annotation implicitly defaulted to None. In Pydantic v2 such fields are required, so omitting them raises 'Field required'. Adding explicit `= None` restores the v1 behavior. profile_from_form drops empty/None form values before calling Profile(...), so the missing keys now default to None, which fixes the test_blank_fields_become_none failure at line 15 without changing that function."}], "notes": "One edit covers the three optional-no-default findings (lines 8-10) by adding `= None` defaults, matching v1 semantics. The test-failure finding (line 15) has the same root cause: profile_from_form filters out blank values, so bio/website/age are absent from the kwargs and v2 treats them as required. The defaults fix it, so profile_from_form is left untouched. No other v1 APIs are used in this file (`List[str] = []` is valid in v2 and was left as-is), so no import changes are needed."}
